# Northern field log miscellany

## Sable Moraine
The Sable Moraine entry records lichen cover and a surface temperature of 3 °C.
No acidity measurement was taken there.

## Buoys
Buoy Kappa flashes every nine seconds and transmits on channel 14.
Buoy Lambda has a nine-sided reflector but no timing or radio entry.

## Quartz Fen proposal
The team tested the words “silver mesh,” “north bank,” and “winter deployment” in a draft for Quartz Fen, then cancelled the deployment without choosing mesh or bank.

## Comet Lichen
The “Comet Lichen” specimen CL-772 is photographed beside a scale card.
